name: Internal Meeting Minutes Summarizer
description: An internal tool that turns Arabic or English meeting notes typed by employees into a short summary and action-item list. The employee reviews and edits the draft before sharing it. It does not make or influence any decision about a person.
documentation:
INPUT: meeting notes only. An input filter redacts phone numbers, emails and ID numbers before the text reaches the model.
HOSTING: model runs in a cloud region inside Saudi Arabia under a signed data processing agreement; no data leaves the Kingdom.
HUMAN OVERSIGHT: summaries are never sent automatically; the employee must review, edit and click Share.
ACCESS AND LOGGING: company SSO only; every request logged with user and timestamp; logs kept 1 year.
RETENTION: notes discarded immediately after the summary is produced.
TRANSPARENCY: every output is labelled 'AI-generated draft - review before sharing'.
QUALITY: PMO reviews 50 random summaries per quarter; prompt-injection tests passed before launch.
